arguments.command:
python -c "
import parse

# Test left-aligned
r = parse.parse('{:<}', 'hello world')
print('Left-aligned:', r)

# Test center-aligned
r = parse.parse('{:^}', 'hello world')
print('Center-aligned:', r)

# Test right-aligned (should still work as before)
r = parse.parse('{:>}', 'hello world')
print('Right-aligned:', r)

# Test with name
r = parse.parse('{name:<}', 'hello world')
print('Named left:', r)

# Test doc example
r = parse.parse('with {:>} herring', 'with     a herring')
print('Doc example:', r)
" 2>&1 | grep -v SyntaxWarning
